response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS mean_pd FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_len) AS avg_of_avg_length, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(r.per_day - m.mean_pd) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.per_day > m.mean_pd
